responsibility: Implements the sanitizer optimization and expansion pass that runs after sanitizer instrumentation has introduced GCC internal sanitizer calls, deduplicating and simplifying checks and then lowering them into target runtime actions. It tracks per-basic-block facts to remove redundant ASan/HWASan and UBSan checks, rewrites address-taken parameters for stack sanitization, handles ASAN_MARK poisoning state, decides when ASan/HWASan memory checks should use helper calls, and dispatches expansion of IFN_UBSAN_*, IFN_ASAN_*, and IFN_HWASAN_* internal functions into the concrete GIMPLE sequences produced by the sanitizer-specific helpers.
